title: Memory Match
tagline: Flip the cards and find the matching animal twins!
howToPlay: Tap two cards to turn them over and hear each animal's name. Find all the matching pairs! Choose how they match: 🐶🐶 twins, 🐮🔊 an animal and its sound (listen carefully, the speaker card only makes the noise), or 🐮 and its baby (a cow's baby is a calf). Tap 👀 once a round to peek at a pair. Start with 2 pairs and grow up to 10.
learning: Visual and auditory memory, animal names and baby animal words
